Signing in adds this TV to your Telegram devices, just like a computer, and there is no server of ours in between.} desktop {TMPlayer talks to Telegram directly. Signing in adds this computer to your Telegram devices, and there is no server of ours in between.} other {TMPlayer talks to Telegram directly. Signing in adds this phone to your Telegram devices, just like a computer, and there is no server of ours in between.}}

Star the chats you watch from and they sit in Favourites, one press away.} desktop {The sidebar sorts them: channels, groups, people, or everything at once. Star the chats you watch from and they sit in Favourites, one click away.} other {The menu sorts them: channels, groups, people, or everything at once. Star the chats you watch from and they sit in Favourites, one tap away.}}

onboarding.language_body: TMPlayer follows the language your device uses. Pick another one here, or later in Settings.
